name: PURIFIED AFFINE ANTIBODIES / RELATED TO INTERFERON / GAMMA HUMAN ADULT 20 TABLETS
description: The medication you are describing is Anaferon Adult 20 tablets. Its active ingredient is affinopurified antibodies to human interferon gamma, which act as an antiviral and immunomodulator to treat and prevent acute respiratory infections. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
